SATORI_ACT4.rest.memoryStory:
One door, four chairs. You have forgotten who closed the door last, but remember Koishi taking off her hat, Orin lighting the hall, and Okuu tending the fire.
The memory does not show you the way home. It reminds you who should walk with you.
SATORI_ACT4.boss.presenceBroken: There you are. I never forgot your shadow.
SATORI_ACT4.boss.phase2: I’ll just forget all these bothersome thoughts!
SATORI_ACT4.boss.phase3: All right! This really is the last game!
SATORI_ACT4.boss.lastGame: Be ready for my next move!
SATORI_ACT4.boss.intro.1:
Koishi: “No secretly guessing my next move!”
Satori: “One last game. Then we go home together.”
Okuu: “I’ll be careful! No burning the flowers!”
SATORI_ACT4.boss.intro.2:
Koishi: “No secretly guessing my next move!”
Satori: “One last game. Then we go home together.”
Orin: “Lady Koishi, we are here to bring you home. No more hiding.”
SATORI_ACT4.boss.intro.3:
Koishi: “No secretly guessing my next move!”
Satori: “One last game. Then we go home together.”
Koishi: “Everyone came? ...Fine. Just one last game.”
SATORI_ACT4.boss.intro.4:
Koishi: “No secretly guessing my next move!”
Satori: “One last game. Then we go home together.”
Koishi: “Just you, sister? Then today I’ll play only with you.”
SATORI_GARDEN_ENTRANCE.title: An Unnoticed Door
SATORI_GARDEN_ENTRANCE.pages.INITIAL.des:
The wind at the summit falls still. As you turn away, the purple heartstring tightens in your palm.

A little door stands in the corner. A moment ago, there seemed to be nothing there. Now a familiar laugh drifts through it.

You recognize the yellow ribbon from that black hat. Koishi is just beyond the door.

Will you follow her, or keep the clue and end today’s journey?
SATORI_GARDEN_ENTRANCE.pages.INITIAL.opt: Enter optional Act 4: Rest → Shop → Visitors → Komeiji Koishi.
Keep your normal victory and continue to the original ending.
SATORI_GARDEN_ENTRANCE.pages.ENTER.descr: The other end of the heartstring slips through the doorway. You hold on and enter the unnoticed garden.
SATORI_GARDEN_ENTRANCE.pages.LEAVE.descr: You put the heartstring away carefully. You have come far enough today. You will remember this door.
SATORI_GARDEN_VISITORS.title: Visitors from the Palace
SATORI_GARDEN_VISITORS.pages.INITIAL.des:
The laughter beyond the gate comes and goes. Before you can open it, two familiar minds catch up behind you.

Orin: “Lady Satori! Lady Koishi says there are new games every day. She won’t leave.”

Okuu: “Then let’s finish playing! After that, we all go home!”

Orin: “Who stayed to play another whole day last time?”

Okuu: “...This time, for sure.”

Who will help you finish this last game?
SATORI_GARDEN_VISITORS.pages.INITIAL.opt: Okuu joins the final battle. Every 3 of your turns, deal 30 damage.
Orin joins the final battle. At the start of your turn, deal 5 damage and gain 6 Block.
Both Orin and Okuu join the final battle. Requires a Precious Memory.
Locked: choose Remember at Act 4’s rest site to obtain a Precious Memory.
Go alone. Start the final battle with a 0-cost, Innate Omniscience+. It keeps Ethereal and is not added to your permanent deck.
SATORI_GARDEN_VISITORS.pages.OKUU.descri:
Okuu: “Leave it to me! But I shouldn’t burn the garden... right?”
Satori: “Right.”

Okuu dims her control rod and takes her place beside you.
SATORI_GARDEN_VISITORS.pages.ORIN.descri:
Orin: “Of course. Dinner can’t wait forever.”

Blue spirits circle Orin’s shoulder as she smiles and opens the gate.
SATORI_GARDEN_VISITORS.pages.BOTH.descri:
Satori: “When we get home, let’s have another evening like that.”
Orin: “You still remember.”
Okuu: “Then I’ll tend the fire!”

The heartstring stays warm. Together, you enter the garden.
SATORI_GARDEN_VISITORS.pages.ALONE.descr:
Satori: “Wait here. I’ll bring her home.”
Orin: “All right. We’ll keep the way back open.”

You stop trying to read the silence and remember the shadow that has always been beside you.
SATORI_HOMECOMING.title: Always There
SATORI_HOMECOMING.pages.INITIAL.descript:
Koishi gathers her purple threads. She does not fall; she sits on the garden steps, swinging her feet.

Koishi: “You were amazing today, sister. What about tomorrow?”
Satori: “We can think about tomorrow when we’re home.”
Koishi: “Is my place still there?”
Satori: “Always.”

Koishi offers you her hand. This time, you do not guess what she is thinking.
SATORI_HOMECOMING.pages.TOGETHER.descrip:
Koishi gathers her purple threads. She does not fall; she sits on the garden steps, swinging her feet.

Koishi: “You were amazing today, sister. What about tomorrow?”
Satori: “We can think about tomorrow when we’re home.”
Koishi: “Is my place still there?”
Satori: “Always.”

Koishi offers you her hand. This time, you do not guess what she is thinking.

Outside the gate, the company waiting for you brightens the way home. At last, dinner can begin.

SATORICHARACTER-SATORI_GARDEN_VISITORS.p:
A light glows in the garden. Koishi's shadow flits behind the gate, then disappears.
Orin: “Lady Satori, we came to bring her home too.”
Okuu: “She says she wants to play a little longer.”
Orin: “There were so many forks on the way here. Someone should stay behind to guide us back.”
Satori: “I'll go find Koishi. Who will come with me?”
You rest your hand on the gate and look at the two of them.
In the final battle, gain Nuclear Support every 2 turns, at the start of even turns.
In the final battle, gain Spirit Escort at the start of every turn.
This time, no one stays behind
At turn start: Okuu gives Nuclear Support every 2 turns; Orin gives Spirit Escort every turn.
This time, no one stays behind
Locked: choose Remember at Act 4’s rest site to obtain a Precious Memory.
I'd like a moment alone with her
Go alone, gaining Omniscience+ for the final battle.

Satori: “Okuu, come with me. Orin, please watch the way back.”
Orin: “Of course. I'll wait at the crossroads for you.”
Okuu: “Leave Lady Koishi to us!”

Satori: “Orin, come inside with me. Okuu, keep this path lit until we return.”
Okuu: “Yes! You'll see the light as soon as you step out!”
Orin: “Let's go, before she finds somewhere else to hide.”

In the memory, the light by that door never goes out. You steady yourself and find your bearings for the journey home.
Satori: “I know the way back now. Both of you, come with me.”
Orin: “Then I'll leave the spirits at the crossroads, and we can all go in.”
Okuu: “Yes! No one stays behind!”

Satori: “I'll go in alone and talk with her. Please keep the way back open.”
Orin: “All right. I'll watch the crossroads.”
Okuu: “Then I'll light the gate! Lady Satori, bring her back with you.”

SATORI_ACT4.boss.bubble.intro.koishi: Sister, are you staying to play too?
SATORI_ACT4.boss.bubble.intro.satori: This Spire is dangerous, Koishi. It isn't a place to play. Let's go home together.
SATORI_ACT4.boss.bubble.intro.2: Lady Koishi, we're here to bring you home. No more hiding.
SATORI_ACT4.boss.bubble.intro.3: Everyone's here... Then let's all play together.
SATORI_ACT4.boss.bubble.intro.4: You came to fetch me all on your own, sister? Then this game is just for us.
